Profit after tax stood at INR 11.2 crore, up 16.9% sequentially, demonstrating improving operational momentum a s we enter FY27.
Growth & demand: These investments are strengthening our competitive differentiation, improving speed to value for customers and creating a scalable platform for future growth .
We are also seeing increased demand from global enterprises investing in software-defined products, AI-enabled engineering, automation, digital manufacturing and intelligent products.

Capex & expansion: These are the outcomes of strategic investments we have made over the last few years in digital engineering, ER&D, and offshore delivery expansion, leadership capability, and account mining.

Importantly, we also completed our first -ever buyback programmeme during the quarter, reinforcing our confidence in the business, our cash generation capabilities and our long -term growth outlook.
As committed, the promoters did not participate in the buyback programme.
